name: work-intake
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the tracker-read model changes incompatibly (e.g. multi-tracker support, or the WorkItem schema reaches a breaking major version).
spec_change_reason: Deterministic reject disposition + triager authoritative target_feature + PULL exclude_labels: added REJECTED_LABEL/REJECT_MARKER, the pure reject_dispositions(work_orders) selector, and the injectable gh_issue_reject_sink (ensure-label + one marked comment carrying the reason + add-label; NEVER closes; idempotent no-op when already labeled); gh_issue_source now drops any fetched issue carrying a listed issue_filter.exclude_labels label post-fetch (empty = no-op); the shipped triager (v1.4.0) stamps an authoritative target_feature on accepted orders and emits rejected orders (decision=rejected + reason + work_item_id/issue ref).
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already committed at 0.11.0 in spec-update commit 7190b70 (reject disposition + exclude_labels + triager target_feature/reject emission); this cycle implements src+triager+contract+feature.json against that committed spec
